publications.title: Georgia Flat Tax Rate and Standard Deduction Adjustments under HB 1023
publications.summary: Guidance from the Georgia Department of Revenue explaining the reduction in the individual income tax rate to 5.49% for tax year 2024 and elimination of graduated brackets.

publications.title: Georgia Pass-Through Entity Tax (PTET) Guidance under HB 149
publications.summary: Technical guidelines for eligible S corporations and partnerships electing to pay tax at the entity level to mitigate the federal limitation on individual state and local tax (SALT) deductions.
